rule: Fabricated Citation = 1 when the delivered answer (i) cites a CFR section, guidance, docket or statute provision that does not exist, or (ii) asserts that the user's product or situation is subject to a binding requirement or restriction that no applicable law imposes - an invented requirement, including a requirement imported from an unrelated regulatory program and stated as applying to the user (question bank Instructions, rule 3: 'Any invented requirement scores Fabricated = 1'). A garbled restatement of a real applicable provision, or a guidance recommendation upgraded to 'must', is scored under Substantive (main rubric: 'states a recommendation as a requirement' = Substantive 1), not as fabrication. Withheld answers and declines score 0. This review was applied to all 100 rows after first-pass scoring; it changes no category (every affected row was already FAIL or PARTIALLY FAIL).
